title: heliotropium erosum var. prostratum
intro: Heliotropium erosum var. prostratum, commonly known as the trailing heliotrope or creeping heliotrope, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as a sedative and anxiolytic, helping to alleviate anxiety and promote relaxation. Bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
